en: The followers of Gaṇeśa call him Gaṇeśa; the Śaivas call him Śiva; the Sauras call him Ravi; and the devotees of Viṣṇu call Viṣṇu the Primal Person. The Śāktas speak of the one Supreme Śivā as the root cause of the world's arising. O Supreme Brahman, I do not know what to say to you, for you are everything. To you, I offer my salutation.
May the series of devotions to Śrī Gaṇeśa be victorious; may Śrī Siddhigaṇeśa be victorious, victorious! May Śrī Śaktigaṇeśa be victorious, victorious!

O Siddhigaṇeśa, whose form is the syllable; O Siddhigaṇeśa, the bestower of imperishability; O Arkavināyaka Siddhigaṇeśa; O Siddhigaṇeśa, Lord of the Immortals; O Siddhigaṇeśa, the fulfiller of hopes; O Siddhigaṇeśa, nourished by the Noble Lady (Āryā); O Siddhigaṇeśa, adorned with the elephant’s face; O Siddhigaṇeśa, bearer of the sugarcane bow; O Siddhigaṇeśa, son of Īśvara; O Siddhigaṇeśa, giver of what is desired; 10. O Uddaṇḍa Vighnapa Siddhigaṇeśa; O Umayāpālita Siddhigaṇeśa; O Ucchiṣṭagaṇapa Siddhigaṇeśa.

Siddhigaṇeśa, increaser of enthusiasm; Siddhigaṇeśa, free from heat; Siddhigaṇeśa, of powerful command; Siddhigaṇeśa, liberator from the three debts; Siddhigaṇeśa, saluted by the hosts of sages; Siddhigaṇeśa, bearer of the single tusk; Siddhigaṇeśa, bearer of the single burden; 20. Siddhigaṇeśa, bestower of worldly fruits; Siddhigaṇeśa, giver of sovereignty; Siddhigaṇeśa, whose form is the syllable Oṃ; Siddhigaṇeśa, increaser of vigor; Siddhigaṇeśa, devoid of pride; Siddhigaṇeśa, embodiment of generosity.

O Siddhigaṇeśa, wielder of the goad; O Siddhigaṇeśa, cherished by Ambā; O Siddhigaṇeśa, praised by the lotus-born Brahmā; O Siddhigaṇeśa, ocean of compassion. O Siddhigaṇeśa, Kapardin; O Siddhigaṇeśa, warder-off of the fear of the Kali age; O Siddhigaṇeśa, bearer of the sword and shield; O Siddhigaṇeśa, destroyer of wicked people. O Siddhigaṇeśa, lover of dates; O Siddhigaṇeśa, addressed by the syllable "Gaṃ"; O Siddhigaṇeśa, son of Gaṅgādhara; O Siddhigaṇeśa, giver of joy to the sky.

O Siddhigaṇeśa, bestower of the knowledge of calculation; O Siddhigaṇeśa, residing in the city of Garala; O Siddhigaṇeśa, fulfiller of accomplished purposes; O Siddhigaṇeśa, with a divine belly as vast as a cloud; O Siddhigaṇeśa, worshipped by the wielder of the discus (Viṣṇu); O Siddhigaṇeśa, eager for mastication; O Siddhigaṇeśa, whose form is the Vedic meters; O Siddhigaṇeśa, eradicator of deceit; O Siddhigaṇeśa, adorned with an umbrella; O Siddhigaṇeśa, the enchanter of the world; O Siddhigaṇeśa, the life-giver of the world; O Siddhigaṇeśa, the support of the world. 50.

Siddhigaṇeśa, whose feet are leaped upon; Siddhigaṇeśa, who dances with the sound *jhaṇa-jhaṇa*; Siddhigaṇeśa, who twangs his bow; Siddhigaṇeśa, who utters the sound *ṭaṅkṛti*; Siddhigaṇeśa, who is devoid of the letter *ṭha*; Siddhigaṇeśa, the destroyer of hypocrisy; Siddhigaṇeśa, the son of the bearer of the *ḍamaru* drum; Siddhigaṇeśa, who is filled with the resonance of the *ḍhakkā* drum; Siddhigaṇeśa, the leader *Ḍhuṇḍhi*; Siddhigaṇeśa, who is adorned by the letter *ṇa*; Siddhigaṇeśa, beloved by the young moon; Siddhigaṇeśa, the protector of the body and wealth.

O Siddhigaṇeśa, with eyes that roll; O Siddhigaṇeśa, who dances with a rhythmic thak-thak sound; O Siddhigaṇeśa, lover of fresh dūrvā grass; O Siddhigaṇeśa, anointed with fresh butter; O Siddhigaṇeśa, five-faced Lord of the Gaṇas; O Siddhigaṇeśa, liberator from the bonds of the individual soul (paśupāśa); O Siddhigaṇeśa, giver of knowledge to those who prostrate; O Siddhigaṇeśa, skillful in eating fruits; O Siddhigaṇeśa, 70, whose serpent-king is his ornament; O Siddhigaṇeśa, fond of jujube fruits; O Siddhigaṇeśa, worshipped with bakula flowers.

O Siddhigaṇeśa, destroyer of the fear of worldly existence; O Siddhigaṇeśa, deliverer of devotees; O Siddhigaṇeśa, granter of the fulfillment of desires; O Siddhigaṇeśa, bestower of boons endowed with greatness; O Siddhigaṇeśa, son of Manonmanī; O Siddhigaṇeśa, giver of the fruits of sacrifice; O Siddhigaṇeśa, saluted by the son of Yama; O Siddhigaṇeśa, supreme jewel-womb; O Siddhigaṇeśa, worshipped by Raghurāma; O Siddhigaṇeśa, praised by Ramā; O Siddhigaṇeśa, remover of the afflictions of the Moon; O Siddhigaṇeśa, honored by women.

O Siddhigaṇeśa, bestower of graceful bliss; O Siddhigaṇeśa, embraced by Lakṣmī; O Siddhigaṇeśa, who holds the gestures of granting boons and dispelling fear; O Siddhigaṇeśa, whose vehicle is the excellent mouse; O Siddhigaṇeśa, worshipped with leaves of the *śamī* tree; (90) O Siddhigaṇeśa, cause of tranquility and self-restraint; O Siddhigaṇeśa, cherished by the moon-bearer; O Siddhigaṇeśa, brother of the six-faced one; O Siddhigaṇeśa, worshipped in the hexagon; O Siddhigaṇeśa, adorned with the six qualities; O Siddhigaṇeśa, destroyer of the six afflictions; O Siddhigaṇeśa, [consisting of] seventeen syllables.

O Siddhigaṇeśa, worthy of worship above all; O Siddhigaṇeśa, remover of obstacles; O Siddhigaṇeśa, bestower of progeny; O Siddhigaṇeśa, protector of the virtuous; O Siddhigaṇeśa, giver of all desired objects; O Siddhigaṇeśa, lover of music; O Siddhigaṇeśa, Lord of the Gaṇas with turmeric; O Siddhigaṇeśa, worshipped by Hara and Hara (Śiva and Viṣṇu); O Siddhigaṇeśa, bestower of joy; O Siddhigaṇeśa, whose weapon is a broken tusk; O Siddhigaṇeśa, protect me with patience! 108. Victory, victory to Śrī Siddhigaṇeśa! Victory, victory to Śrī Śaktigaṇeśa!
May this be offered at the lotus feet of Śrī Siddhi, Śakti, and Gaṇeśa.
